brief: Holds two lists side by side and pairs their items by position.
detail: Build one with new stzPairOfLists(aList1, aList2) or StzPairOfListsQ(aList1, aList2). Associate zips the lists into [ first, second ] pairs and stops at the shorter one; AssociateQRT(:stzHashList) answers the pairs as a hash list. Alternate is meant to interleave the two lists and raises error R24 today for any non-empty pair. The file marks the class as a candidate for generalisation into stzListOfLists.
